videos.caption: Trump said it himself: "they'll find a reason to impeach me. I'll get impeached." Tomorrow, Americans vote. • Jan 6, 2026, at the House GOP Member Retreat (Trump-Kennedy Center), Trump told House Republicans: "If we don't win the midterms… they'll find a reason to impeach me. I'll get impeached." • Democrats lead the generic ballot by about 9 points (Nate Silver Bulletin average, Oct 30). In 2018 they led by about 7 and gained 41 House seats. • The House today: 218 Republicans, 214 Democrats, 3 vacancies. Democrats need a net gain of 3 seats. • Impeachment takes a simple majority of the House. Asked about it, Hakeem Jeffries said: "We haven't ruled anything in or out." • Speaker Mike Johnson, December 2025: "If we lose the House majority, the radical Left… is going to impeach President Trump." • Removal takes two-thirds of the Senate, 67 votes. In February 2021 the vote was 57–43, with 7 Republicans voting guilty. Ten short. • No president has ever been impeached three times. Impeaching is not removing. Tomorrow, voters decide.
